# Practice exam: linked list

1. Implement `sum()` and `free_list()` in `list.c`.
2. Click **Build & Run** (or press Ctrl+Enter). Expected output ends with `sum = 150`.
3. Fix any errors shown in the console; click an error to jump to that line.

Your work saves automatically in this browser.
When you are done, click **Copy all code**, then paste it into the answer box in the quiz tab.
